title: Love the app
body: I really love this app, due to its simplicity and efficiency. The only thing I want to be added is a tag or a label system, for example let’s say for my reading habit I want to add different tags that represents the category that I’ve read today, it will then show in the statistics bars and I can keep track of the most read category (science, history…). Same can apply for training (running, weight lifting, calisthenics..) but just keep it mandatory and simple
author: Fianso1198
